cohort: 100 teenage mothers (13-19 years) and 100 adult mothers (20-26 years) admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Nalanda Medical College and Hospital, Patna, Bihar, India.
finding: Teenage mothers were more likely to be of lower socioeconomic status, housewives, illiterate, living in joint families, and from rural backgrounds compared to adult mothers.
